name: M3_OIS100MI_ReleaseOrder
description: Release the lock on a customer order previously locked with the LockOrder operation in Sales Desk. LockOrder sets an order-header lock code to 9 so integrations can safely add or change lines without interference from other users or jobs. When updates are finished, use ReleaseOrder to set the lock code to 1 and run release processing so normal processing can continue.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number to be released from the LockOrder lock.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company in which the customer order to be released is registered.
